lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn3Te (Zn12Te4, 16 atoms per cell) is hexagonal with space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Te centers four Zn neighbors (2.71–2.75 Å) and Zn centers either three or six geometric neighbors, with one Zn orbit described as close-packed-like. The resulting periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Zn polyhedra and between 12-vertex and 6-vertex Zn polyhedra.
